description: Updates mutable model metadata such as its inference name, description, base model, or visibility.

schema.description: Fields to update. If omitted, all mutable fields are overwritten.

DE.UpdateModelRequest.description: Mutable metadata for a custom model resource.

visibility.description: Who can discover the model. `VISIBILITY_PRIVATE` restricts it to the project; `VISIBILITY_INTERNAL` shares it with the organization.

DE.Model.description: Custom or derived model registered in a project and backed by versioned weight files.

baseModel.description: Resource name of the base model, using `projects/{baseProject}/models/{baseModelId}`; empty when the model has no base.

baseModelId.description: ID of the supported or custom base model from which this model was derived.

description.description: Human-readable description of the model and its intended use.

name.description: Project-qualified model name in the form `<project_slug>/<model_name>`. Create and update requests may use the bare or qualified form.

organizationId.description: ID of the organization that owns the model's project.

projectId.description: ID of the project that owns the model.

visibility.description: Who can discover the model. `VISIBILITY_PRIVATE` restricts it to the project; `VISIBILITY_INTERNAL` shares it with the organization.

weights.description: Architecture, size, precision, and speculative-decoding metadata derived from the model files.

DE.ModelWeights.description: Architecture, size, precision, and speculative-decoding metadata for model weights.

architecture.description: Model architecture detected from the weight metadata.

contextLength.description: Maximum context length reported by the model metadata.

draftSpeculatorType.description: Draft-model speculator family for draft speculative decoding.

parameters.description: Total parameter count and breakdown by numerical data type.

speculatorMechanism.description: Speculative decoding mechanism for speculator weights.

type.description: Role of the weights: full model, speculative draft model, or LoRA adapter.

DE.ModelParameters.description: Model parameter count and precision breakdown.

byDtype.description: Parameter counts grouped by numerical data type.

total.description: Total number of parameters in the model weights.

DE.ModelDTypeCount.description: Number of model parameters stored in one numerical data type.

count.description: Number of model parameters stored with this data type.

dtype.description: Numerical data type, such as `float16`, `bfloat16`, or `int8`.
